stage: Build; not submitted for independent acceptance
scope_interpretation: The confirmed specification requires actual integration, fixed benchmark attempts and honest failed outcomes; it does not require all 27 performance runs to pass. Failed ground tasks are not represented as successful navigation or correct danger refusal. Temporary cleanup is still incomplete, so this is a preparation review, not a completed Builder handoff.

acceptance_review.note: Three real delivered worlds started headlessly, retain original collision geometry/resources and have actual panorama images, linked startup logs and fixed asset provenance.

Two independent fixed-seed generations match six artifacts; 1015 publicly licensed plants, actual CLI arguments, no preset override, weeds or litter. Straight/curved sections replace an upstream nonterminating sincurved generator.

Actual Clearpath-generated distinct J100/A200 assets, sensor extrinsics, footprints and limits are used; X500 depth model, firmware, model submodule, messages and Agent revisions are pinned. Real dimensions were not reduced.
One parameterized world entry selects the robot and attaches PX4 to the selected world. All 27 records report one clock publisher and independent cleanup with no live owned processes remaining.

Both robots run the real simulated sensor -> FAST-LIO -> terrain/FAR -> MPPI -> adapter -> gate -> physical sink assembly. Sensor mappings/fields, frames, QoS and command types/stamps have software/runtime evidence. Actual final four-stage commands are fresh TwistStamped with base_link and unique publisher counts, and controller failures produce explicit zero speed. All 18 navigation tasks fail; positive autonomous chassis motion and successful normal/danger navigation are not proved or claimed.

Required qualification parameters are configured; gate and sink start and retain /cmd_vel/nav input and a unique control output. The older diagnostic resolves the gate node name; the final graph's teardown _NODE_NAME_UNKNOWN_ is retained honestly.
All ground matrix entries explicitly identify simulation_sensors localization; air identifies px4_simulated_sensors. No ground-truth-assisted run is counted in end-to-end statistics.

Actual PX4 SITL performs readiness, arm, Offboard, takeoff, stable hover, four waypoints, centered return, land and disarm in all three worlds, with traces/logs/ULogs retained. Eight of nine flights pass; pipeline r2 leaves the checked home column during takeoff and fails. No robot pose manipulation or animation is used.

Actual transformed world/model collision geometry checks full routes, return, initial X500 boxes and the complete home column before launch; configuration hashes bind the report. Scope is fixed-height waypoint inspection; no three-dimensional avoidance or terrain-following claim.

Exactly nine combinations x three independent fixed-seed resets on one final image and implementation. Results are 8 pass/19 fail/0 blocked/0 not-run. Configuration, seed, localization and original thresholds are recorded; excluded prior matrices and the RViz supplement do not alter counts.

All ground runs attempt normal, measured terrain challenge and dangerous-target cases and record goal error, length, elapsed time, RTF, actual contact collisions, roll/pitch, stall and tip state. All cases fail; a generic controller/odometry error is not relabelled as correct danger refusal. Normal wheel/ground contacts are excluded from unexpected collisions.

Actual telemetry supplies waypoint/height errors, hover, cruise height loss, roll/pitch, instability and landing results. The failed takeoff retains empty waypoint/hover data rather than inventing measurements for unexecuted phases.

Durable JSON/CSV, per-run startup/task logs, measured traces and PX4 ULogs are linked by run IDs. Fifteen images link the corresponding records, including the excluded supplementary capture. Actual slopes/heights and unsupported-physics limitations are recorded. Image-owned unavailable etc symlinks are omitted, not measured data.

Actual 1920x1080 OGRE2/EGL and independent Xvfb/software-GLX RViz paths use fixed camera/view settings. Sidecars preserve run/world/robot/pose/time/status. A historical unchanged real FAR path is display-only and clearly labelled.

Fifteen personally reviewed real images: three panoramas, nine robot/world task views, three RViz views showing measured cloud/terrain, real robot and actual historical path. PNG/JPG and metadata are retained; three JPG main views and relative album/data links appear in README. Pipeline RViz comes from one same-version supplementary run.

Documentation provides build/preparation/runtime/matrix/capture commands, actual results, album, attribution and capability limits. Final incremental FAR/SIM validation is distinguished from the earlier full build; the full production rebuild after patch 0005 was not run.

Existing structures are reused and added dependencies stay in SIM. Main workspace and unrelated baseline changes are preserved, with no stage/commit/push. Required task-local cache cleanup remains incomplete because automatic approval rejected deletion; user manual cleanup is pending. Do not submit this preparation review as a complete candidate.

remaining_work: Complete the explicitly bounded cache cleanup, then verify its absence and update A17 evidence.
